claims.title: Complex-balanced physical-time gap: exact witnesses, pinned spectrum and sufficient algebraic tests

quoted_fields.interface: Every finite rational complex-balanced stochastic mass-action model with supplied positive rational c, exact complex-balance equations, binary stoichiometries/rates and initial x0.
